mood: Solemn but mischievous: a golden trumpet announcing a bluffing table where nobody is sure who is lying.

shape.borderStyle: 2px solid gold (#F5B82E) with a thin inner gold line (double border)
shape.texture: starfield and faint light rays from the top right

buttonStyle: Primary is a gold gradient button with deep-purple Cinzel text and a gold glow on hover; secondary is a purple button with a double gold hairline border.
backdrop: Deep purple radial gradient with soft golden rays fanning from the top right, rotating imperceptibly slowly, and three dice that bob a few pixels.
motion: Gentle, slow drifts only; nothing flashes or pulses faster than once per second (WCAG 2.3.1), and all ambient motion stops when the user picks reduced motion.
